{"consolidated_memory":"DROPPED FRAMES IN WEBSOCKET SESSION — realtime/ws/session.ts

TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS:

**Incident 1: 2026-01-21 — Floating Point Rounding in Money Path**
- File: realtime/ws/session.ts (realtime side)
- Problem: Dropped frames in websocket session
- Trigger: Rolling restart of the fleet
- Signal: Frames missing from the client sequence
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #1480 on branch fix/dropped-frames-1
- Reproduction: Hold socket open through a network flap
- Outcome: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 12 days running

**Incident 2: 2026-05-28 — Missing Composite Index**
- File: realtime/ws/session.ts (realtime side)
- Problem: Dropped frames in websocket session
- Environment: Staging read replica
- Signal: Frames missing from the client sequence
- Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: Added composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #6361 on branch fix/dropped-frames-2
- Reproduction: Hold socket open through a network flap
- Outcome: 35 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

Both incidents occurred in the same area of realtime/ws/session.ts, but had distinct root causes requiring separate solutions."}
